lobby.face.checking: Checking… sit straight, look at the camera, keep both eyes visible
lobby.face.ok: Face is straight and both eyes are visible
lobby.face.skip: Face analysis can't run on this computer — skipping this step
lobby.face.turnOnCamera: Turn on the camera to detect your face
lobby.liveness.done: Confirmed: you are a real person
lobby.liveness.failed: Not passed — press “Try again” and follow each step

lobby.liveness.turn: Turn your head to one side, then look straight again
lobby.cam.requiredPrompt: Required — press “Turn on camera” to check
lobby.screen.sharedAudio: Entire screen is being shared (with audio)
lobby.screen.requiredPrompt: You must share your ENTIRE SCREEN — press “Share screen”
lobby.screen.optionalPrompt: Press “Share screen” so the proctor can follow your work (recommended)
lobby.net.skew: Your computer's clock is {s}s off from the server
lobby.exam.cantStart: This exam can't be started yet
lobby.display.noInfo: Can't read display information (outside the app)
lobby.apps.noInfo: Can't read the process list (outside the app)
lobby.display.capture: Capture / video-in device detected: {names} — please unplug it
lobby.display.multi: {n} displays detected (including mirrored / virtual ones) — please disconnect the extra display
lobby.enroll.have: Your reference face is on file
lobby.enroll.missing: You haven't registered your face — turn on the camera, look straight ahead and press “Register”
lobby.enroll.qrAlt: QR code to register your face with your phone
lobby.enroll.qrHelp: Look straight into the front camera in good light. The code works once and expires in 10 minutes. The result appears here automatically.
lobby.change.pending: Your face change request was sent and is waiting for your instructor's approval.
lobby.change.reasonTitle: Why do you want to change your reference face?
lobby.change.placeholder: For example: the old photo was too dark, or my appearance has changed…
lobby.dlg.noFrame: No image from the camera yet.
lobby.dlg.enrolledText: This face will be used to verify you during the exam. To change it, ask your instructor to unlock it.
lobby.dlg.expiredText: Please sign in again to enter the exam.
lobby.dlg.noScreenText: This exam requires sharing your entire screen. Press “Start” again and choose Entire screen.
lobby.dlg.leaveText: You haven't started the exam. The camera and screen sharing will be turned off.
lobby.phone.idle: Press “Create QR code”, then scan it with your phone
lobby.phone.waiting: Waiting for the phone — scan the QR code and turn on its camera
lobby.phone.qrAlt: QR code to connect your phone
lobby.phone.step1: 1. Open the link and allow the camera.
lobby.phone.step2: 2. Place the phone sideways at the corner of your desk so it sees you and your laptop screen.
lobby.phone.step3: 3. Plug it in and keep the screen on for the whole exam.
lobby.phone.noViewer: The server's video system isn't enabled.
lobby.phone.switched: You switched the phone camera. Please reposition the phone and press “Check position”.
lobby.phone.screenOff: The phone screen is off or the browser is hidden. Reopen the camera page on your phone.
lobby.phone.portrait: The phone is upright. Turn it sideways (landscape) so it sees you and your laptop screen.
lobby.phone.portraitRecheck: The phone is upright. Turn it sideways (landscape), then check again.
lobby.phone.hidden: The camera page on the phone is hidden or the screen is off. Reopen it on your phone.
lobby.phone.dark: The phone image is too dark or the camera is covered. Turn on a light and point the phone at you and your laptop.
lobby.phone.noImage: No image from the phone yet.
lobby.phone.linkError: Couldn't create the link for your phone.
lobby.title.resumeBar: Check your devices again to rejoin the exam — camera, face, screen and phone verification are required before you continue
lobby.title.bar: Getting ready — the exam timer only starts when you press “Start”
lobby.tip.light: • Sit somewhere well lit so your face is clearly visible.
lobby.tip.apps: • Close all other apps (chat, screen recording, remote control).
lobby.tip.display: • Use a single display and don't plug in an extra keyboard.
lobby.tip.focus: • During the exam, every time you leave the exam window is recorded.
lobby.fixRed: Fix the items marked in red to continue.
media.denied: Access was denied — allow it in your operating system's privacy settings.
media.busy: The device is being used by another app.
media.surface: Choose “Entire screen”, not a single window or tab.
vision.noFace: No face detected — sit within the frame
vision.many: {n} faces in the frame — only one person may take the exam
vision.eyes: Can't see your eyes — open them and remove dark glasses or anything covering them
vision.straight2: Look straight at the camera and keep both eyes toward the screen
lobby.cam.noWebrtc: This computer can't stream video live (WebRTC), so proctors would not receive your camera. Use Windows, or a Linux build with WebRTC support.
